title: Supplemental hourly weather data
scenario: Inspect the server1 v000903 coordinate response for an overseas location. The example was captured from a local HTTP request with an isolated MongoDB and a Tokyo forecast fixture supplemented with synthetic metrics.

steps.title: Read the hourly forecast details
steps.instruction: Request /weather/v000903/coord/35.69,139.692 with the regular weather parameters. Find the optional hourlyDetails array. Read each row by its UTC at timestamp. If the field is absent, continue using the ordinary forecast.
steps.caption: Selected fields from the HTTP reply after a MongoDB cache hit.
steps.expected: UV, gust (m/s), WBGT (Celsius), irradiance (W/m²), energy (MJ/m²) and the provider storm-risk score appear when available. The three-hour chart continues to use hourly.
